description: Compare Pendle Boros fixed funding rates with realised floating funding. For every live Boros market (a venue's perp to a maturity: Binance, OKX, Bybit, Gate, KuCoin, Hyperliquid incl. xyz, Lighter) returns impliedApr (Boros's fixed rate), floatingApr (the venue's current funding as Boros reports it), realised7dApr and realised30dApr (Sharpe's stored funding for the same contract, annualised as acc × 365 / days), and spread7dApr / spread30dApr = implied − realised. A positive spread means locking the fixed rate (sell yield on Boros, receive fixed) beats what the floating leg has paid; negative means the fixed rate is cheap to pay. All rates are fractions per year (0.05 = 5%), gross of fees. Realised figures are null with realised7dNullReason / realised30dNullReason when the contract is not covered or its history is incomplete, never 0. Also serves bestBidApr / bestAskApr, daysToMaturity, openInterestUsd (one side) and a Boros trade link. Filter with coin and venue.

coin.description: Underlying asset, case-insensitive (BTC, ETH, HYPE, BRENTOIL).

venue.description: Filter to one venue, case-insensitive: Boros's name (Binance, OKX, Hyperliquid, Gate, Kucoin, Lighter, Bybit) or our funding store's (Gate.io, KuCoin, tradeXYZ).

name: get_arbitrage_fixed_floating_funding

bestBidApr.description: Best bid APR: the fixed rate a seller of yield (receive fixed, pay floating) gets now.

borosAsOf.description: Block time of the Boros indexer head the market was read at.

collateral.description: Boros collateral token (BTC, ETH, USDT, HYPE, BNB).

daysToMaturity.description: Fractional days from the answer's generation to maturity.

edge30dApr.description: The 30-day executable edge: bestBidApr − realised30dApr to receive fixed, realised30dApr − bestAskApr to pay fixed, the larger. Gross of fees; null without a quote or the realised figure.

edge30dSide.description: The side edge30dApr trades: receive_fixed (sell yield at the bid) or pay_fixed (buy yield at the ask); null without an edge.

edge7dApr.description: The 7-day executable edge: bestBidApr − realised7dApr to receive fixed, realised7dApr − bestAskApr to pay fixed, the larger. Gross of fees; null without a quote or the realised figure.

floatingApr.description: The underlying (floating) APR as Boros reports it: the venue's current funding annualised by Boros's oracle.

fundingAsOf.description: When the funding_accumulated view behind the realised figures was refreshed; null when not covered.

fundingContract.description: The matched perp's native symbol as /v1/funding/rates serves it (BTCUSDT, BTC-USDT-SWAP, XBTUSDTM, BTC-USD, xyz:BRENTOIL); null when not covered.

fundingExchange.description: Our funding store's exchange for the matched contract (Gate.io, KuCoin, tradeXYZ for Hyperliquid's xyz dex); null when not covered.

impliedApr.description: Boros implied (fixed) APR: the market's mark (fair-value) rate.

marketId.description: Boros market id (the key: one venue contract can list twice on different collateral).

netEdge30dApr.description: edge30dApr − takerFeeApr − settleFeeApr: the 30-day executable edge net of Boros fees, held to maturity (the rank key). Gross of any venue fee on a perp held beside it. Null without the edge or either fee.

openInterestUsd.description: Boros open interest, one side: notionalOI (yield units of the collateral token) × the collateral's USD price.

realised30dApr.description: Realised funding over the last 30 days, annualised: acc_30d × 365 / 30.

anyOf.description: Why the realised figure is null (never 0): venue_not_covered (Boros quotes a venue or Hyperliquid builder dex our funding store does not track), contract_not_in_store (no accumulated funding row for the contract), store_unavailable (the funding store could not be read), accumulated_stale (the 7/30-day sums are past their freshness SLA), listed_within_window (the contract's first stored settlement is inside the window), history_stale (its last stored settlement is over a day old).

realised7dApr.description: Our realised funding for the same venue contract over the last 7 days, annualised: acc_7d × 365 / 7 (funding_accumulated).

anyOf.description: Why the realised figure is null (never 0): venue_not_covered (Boros quotes a venue or Hyperliquid builder dex our funding store does not track), contract_not_in_store (no accumulated funding row for the contract), store_unavailable (the funding store could not be read), accumulated_stale (the 7/30-day sums are past their freshness SLA), listed_within_window (the contract's first stored settlement is inside the window), history_stale (its last stored settlement is over a day old).

settleFeeApr.description: Boros settlement fee, a fraction per year charged on each settlement (extConfig.settleFeeRate / 1e18). Null when Boros does not report it.

settlementIntervalHours.description: The underlying perp's settlement interval, hours (Boros paymentPeriod).

spread30dApr.description: impliedApr − realised30dApr: a valuation at the mark, not the rank key (netEdge30dApr is). Gross: no Boros or venue fees.

spread7dApr.description: impliedApr − realised7dApr. Positive: locking the fixed rate beats what the floating leg paid over 7 days. Gross: no Boros or venue fees.

takerFeeApr.description: Boros taker fee, a fraction per year of the time to maturity (config.takerFee / 1e18): a taker entry held to maturity costs this much a year. Null when Boros does not report it.

venue.description: The venue whose perp funding the market settles against, as Boros names it (Binance, OKX, Hyperliquid, Gate, Kucoin, Lighter, Bybit).

unmatched.description: Markets without a realised 7-day figure, by realised7dNullReason.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: Fixed vs floating funding (Pendle Boros)
